description: The initial lane worker checkpoint serialized growing outcome, candidate, and call arrays after every target. The coordinator interrupted all five workers before scale-up, confirmed that lanes 2-5 had accepted no rows and lane 1 had accepted exactly two terminal outcomes, migrated those accepted rows to append-only ledgers, and replaced the checkpoint with a small atomic progress record.
repair: append-only accepted outcome, candidate, and call ledgers plus small atomic per-row checkpoint
resume_rule: lane 1 resumes after its two accepted rows; lanes 2-5 retain their original absolute stagger schedule
